data.body: **P2:** Continuations are still quiesced only by `close()`, after `DurableExecutor` has selected the output and called `onInvocationEnd`. An admitted READY continuation can therefore checkpoint, emit hooks, or fail after plugins reported/flushed `SUCCEEDED`; if the handler already won the completion race, that failure can be lost and the invocation can return success. Close continuation admission and drain admitted work before finalizing the output and invocation hooks, then recheck any selected continuation failure before publishing the status. Add a `DurableExecutor` test where an unawaited continuation is held across handler return.
